policy.executions: 18 units x B/A/S/AS/P x 3 fresh Decision calls = 270; zero new vision calls
policy.limits: three runs/three blocks; coverage-selected panel; unverified served weights/news PIT/domain validity; prompt/consensus and CASH propensity can still confound information claims
policy.multiplicity: seven BA contrasts declared together before new calls; descriptive joint finite-draw max-deviation envelope, no p-values or calibrated family-wise coverage claim; old interaction added after old inference
policy.other_metrics: accuracy/MCC/macro-F1/LONG frequency/account return are descriptive secondary endpoints, not additional significance discoveries
policy.placebo: one whole past training donor rank-vector, no per-factor independent shuffle; same current names/headings/schema, donor values/signals/skill fields by rank; not name-matched factor covariance
policy.prompt: five explicit factor rows bypass legacy alpha distillation; same AS/P skeleton and limits, exact token length not asserted
policy.reuse: only archived upstream reports, numerical assets and donor map; every Decision response is new in this study
policy.scope: new historical exploratory value-control panel; not prospective confirmation
policy.units: same frozen 18 sentiment-available units; no outcome-based reselection
